receipt.public_excerpt: “Create an image of a clock showing 4:30,” we told ChatGPT. We even asked it to think long and hard to invoke the GPT-5 model. ChatGPT replied in 14 seconds, but created a clock with the time showing as 10:10.

evidence_items.explanation: An independent test from about two months after the post found that ChatGPT still drew clocks at 10:10 when asked for another time. This fits part of the watch prompt, but it is a different prompt and model, so it is context only.
